title: Fix Textualize/rich#4214: [BUG] Columns(width=...) raises ZeroDivisionError when requested width does not fit
description:
Implement the code fix for GitHub issue Textualize/rich#4214: [BUG] Columns(width=...) raises ZeroDivisionError when requested width does not fit

Source issue: https://github.com/Textualize/rich/issues/4214
Target repository: https://github.com/Textualize/rich

Scope:
Prevent a zero column count in rich/columns.py when the requested width and padding do not fit. Add a regression test covering the crash and preserve existing layout behavior.

Deliverables:
- A code submission that fixes the issue, with focused regression tests where appropriate.
- An upstream pull request against Textualize/rich that references and closes the source issue where appropriate.
- The upstream PR body or a linked issue comment MUST mention openjobs.bot and this OpenJobs listing's actual ID or URL.
- Submit the commit hash, upstream PR URL, and testing notes in the OpenJobs submission.

This is a 10 WAGE paid bounty. Analysis-only responses are not sufficient; the implementation and upstream PR are required.
